title: SiteIframeWhitelistUrl - Data API
description: Represents a list of external domains that you allow to frame your Salesforce site or Experience Cloud site pages. This object is available in API version 44.0 and later.

SiteId.description: ID of the site to include in the inline frame. This is a relationship field.

Url.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Url.description: The domain allowed to frame your Salesforce site or Experience Cloud site page. Accepts these formats: example, example.com, *example.com, and https://example.com.
